title: Marching with Buddy Petit, Chris Kelly and Manuel Perez
summary: He names the parade bands he marched with and a clarinetist who made women cry at funerals.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Now you're talking about these marching bands, uh, the bands of New Orleans, you know, going to the funeral and, uh, other occasions and all. Who were some of the people that you might have, uh, marched with? Was Louis Armstrong along with you at the time?

No. I marched with, uh, Buddy Petit. I marched with a guy named Chris Kelly. I marched with, uh, Manuel Perez. Mm-hmm. And, uh, there was a clarinetist, uh, I can't think of his name offhand. Well, he used to play so beautiful at a funeral that all of the women would start crying when they'd start playing. And, uh, but he moved, well, he left New Orleans and he went, and the last time I saw him, that was years ago, he was living in Philadelphia. Mm-hmm. I'll think of his name during the course of the night. But he was real great. He was a great clarinetist.
